notes.en: Install that keeps Yasmine in Bayani Mode until the timer ends; timer lasts 1500 frames (25 seconds) and freezes during hitstop; cannot build additional Super gauge while the install is active; grants access to a new special move Linya ng Liwanag (fast cross-up slash); changes the properties of OD Alon (new cinematic ender); each activation of an enhanced Bayani Mode special consumes 375f from the install timer (25%)
Dashes quickly behind the opponent and hits cross-up; puts opponent into a limited juggle state; consumes 375f (25%) of SA2 install timer

Puts Yasmine into Bayani Mode on hit; transitions into a fully invincible cinematic on hit (1st hit can trade for 500 damage); fast reversal and a strong anti-air even at close ranges

Cinematic time regenerates ~2.2 Drive bars for Yasmine; can be used against projectiles from about round-start distance if it catches an extended hurtbox; tall hitbox can anti-air at long range but whiffs under close/mid range opponents; leaves Yasmine fullscreen on hit even if the opponent was cornered; can still get oki with Drive Rush into a delayed normal but cannot get into throw range

Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Yasmine; can be used against projectiles from about round-start distance if it catches an extended hurtbox; tall hitbox can anti-air at long range but whiffs under close/mid range opponents; gives +1 oki after forward dash near the edge of throw range (opponent can back walk to avoid Throw or a chain after 2LK); can also Drive Rush for stronger pressure and bait 6f reversals with DR~2LP

See [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Parry|Drive Parry]]. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

See [[Street_Fighter_6/Gauges#Drive_Rush|Drive Rush]]; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties
